Subject: Vendor onboarding: initial info needed for vendor setup

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for agreeing to get set up in our supplier system. To get the vendor record created and a PO issued we need a short set of intake items from you — attaching our vendor_onboarding_checklist.pdf and a fillable vendor_template_form.docx to speed things up.

At minimum we need:
- Legal entity name and any DBA
- Registered address and remit-to address (if different)
- Tax ID (EIN/TIN) and completed W-9 (for US entities) or VAT registration for EU
- Preferred payment method (ACH or wire)
- Bank details for ACH: bank name, routing number, account number, account type (checking/savings)
- For wires: bank name, SWIFT/BIC, IBAN (if applicable), beneficiary name and beneficiary address
- A bank letter or voided check for account validation (PDF)

If you prefer not to email bank details, you can upload documents securely here: https://redwood-secure-upload.example.com/secure/abcd1234.

Typical timeline: once vendor info + required docs are received we create the vendor record and finance issues an initial PO (usually within 1-2 business days). If anything is sensitive, note it and we can provide a DocuSign/secure portal option.

Cc-ing Ben from AP so he’s aware.

Thanks — appreciate a reply with estimated turnaround and any questions.

Best,
Dev Patel
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
